panels.caption: TAVI · Layout properties › QA NDC ADM · assigning it to QA NDC Accounting is refused
NDC Zoho · Add Ticket › Accounting · the agent picks the form: Accounting or ADM (ADM is the default)

rows: Second layout for the same department

Accounting has two active layouts, "Accounting" (18 fields, normal requests) and "ADM" (42 fields, ADM disputes). NDC Finance has "NDC Finance" and "NDC Finance TKT" (top-up requests). The Add Ticket form has a Layout picker.

QA NDC ADM cannot be given to QA NDC Accounting: "A department can use only one layout of a module; 1 of these departments already use 'QA NDC Accounting'." The ADM and NDC Finance TKT layouts stay unassigned.
The form shows the chosen layout's fields and mandatory fields (ADM: IATA Source, ADM Number, Airline Code, ADM Reason …).
Not possible: a department's tickets always use its single layout, so ADM disputes and top-up requests cannot get their own form.
